name: io.github.contextstream/machinestream-mcp
title: MachineStream
description: Remote builds, tests, lints and type checks for AI coding agents, on your exact checkout.

environmentVariables.name: MACHINESTREAM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of your MachineStream (ContextStream) account. Optional: without it, sign in with the setup tool or `machinestream-mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: MACHINESTREAM_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The git checkout checks are about, for clients that do not start the server in the project folder.

environmentVariables.name: MACHINESTREAM_LOCAL_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the server run a command on this machine itself when the service does not run it remotely. Off by default.
